lightTypes.name: Default, flat profile
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant light source. Used as a reference for non-flickering light sources.

lightTypes.name: Incandescent Light Source 100Hz
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by power grid frequency (Europe, Asia). Used for incandescent light sources, halogen lamps, and some fluorescent lamps.

lightTypes.name: Incandescent Light Source 120Hz
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by power grid frequency (USA, Canada). Used for incandescent light sources, halogen lamps, and some fluorescent lamps.

lightTypes.name: LED 75% Duty Cycle
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LEDs at Daytime.

lightTypes.name: LED 25% Duty Cycle
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LEDs at Nighttime.

lightTypes.name: Halogen headlight
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant halogen light source. Can be used for low and high beam head lights, very commonly used for vehicle headlighs.

lightTypes.name: HID Xenon headlight
lightTypes.description: Very high operating frequency due to HID ballast. Can be used for low and high beam head lights, typically seen on newer or luxury vehicles.

lightTypes.name: Matrix LED headlight
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Can be used for low and high beam head lights, typically seen on new high spec vehicles.

lightTypes.name: DRL and indicator LEDs
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LED lights that are used as both DRL and indicator lights.

lightTypes.name: Halogen indicator
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant halogen light source. Most common type of indicator light.

lightTypes.name: Halogen tail light
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant halogen light source. Most common type of tail light.

lightTypes.name: LED tail light
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LED tail lights, typically seen on newer or luxury vehicles.

lightTypes.name: Halogen brake light
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant halogen light source. Most common type of brake light.

lightTypes.name: LED brake light
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LED brake lights, typically seen on newer or luxury vehicles.

lightTypes.name: Halogen front fog light
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant halogen light source. Most common type of front fog light.

lightTypes.name: LED front fog light
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LED front fog lights, typically seen on newer or luxury vehicles.

lightTypes.name: Halogen rear fog light
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant halogen light source. Most common type of rear fog light.

lightTypes.name: LED rear fog light
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LED rear fog lights, typically seen on newer or luxury vehicles.

lightTypes.name: Halogen reverse light
lightTypes.description: No flickering, constant halogen light source. Most common type of reverse light.

lightTypes.name: LED reverse light
lightTypes.description: Flickering driven by PWM dimming. Used for LED reverse lights, typically seen on newer or luxury vehicles.
